findings.source_excerpt: title: "Transformation laws and S_3-action of the modular lambda function"
findings.observation: The title renders S_3 with a literal underscore instead of a subscript.

findings.source_excerpt: **Proof technique:** build the Hayman lacunary series $\sum_n(z/r_n)^{\lambda_n}$ with super-exponentially growing exponents, estimate it from above and its derivative from below on the lacunary circles, and compare the standard proximity of $f'/f$ with the characteristic of $f$.
findings.observation: The CSS-uppercase technique banner displays the math delimiters and TeX commands literally (including \sum, subscripts, and exponent syntax). Uppercasing the banner itself is expected; the raw math within it is the defect.

source_claims: Under w=z^2, lines x=c (c nonzero) and y=d (d nonzero) map to opposite-opening parabolas; coordinate axes map to opposite rays.
At each nonzero grid crossing, image tangent directions remain orthogonal; the origin is critical.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: complex-map image with two curve families and critical point
diagram_candidates.reason: The example is explicitly about the geometric images of a Cartesian grid and orthogonality, which is easier to verify visually than from coordinate elimination alone.
content_to_draw_or_check: z-plane: representative x=c and y=d lines crossing at z=c+id; show x=0 and y=0 as exceptional axes.
w-plane: x=c maps to u=c^2-v^2/(4c^2), a left-opening parabola; y=d maps to u=v^2/(4d^2)-d^2, a right-opening parabola.
Show the corresponding axis images as nonpositive and nonnegative real rays meeting at w=0.
At a nonzero crossing, mark perpendicular tangents and the map w=z^2; at origin mark f'(0)=0 and withhold the conformality assertion.

source_claims: Cayley map carries upper half-plane biholomorphically to disc and preserves the stated hyperbolic distance under metric transport.
Disc geodesics are arcs of circles/lines meeting unit circle orthogonally; half-plane geodesics are vertical lines or circles centered on the real axis.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: paired domain/codomain geodesic schematic under Cayley map
diagram_candidates.reason: The example gives a concrete correspondence between two standard geodesic geometries and a named map, making a paired schematic useful to orient the stated descriptions.
content_to_draw_or_check: Unit disc with a representative orthogonal-circle geodesic and a diameter case, with endpoints on the unit circle.
Upper half-plane with a representative vertical geodesic and a semicircle centered on the real axis.
Show Cayley map C(w)=(w-i)/(w+i) between domains and endpoint correspondence on boundaries; distinguish the metric-preserving map direction.
